author: Collin Times
title: Keith Self chairs Balkans hearing and issues statement on immigration - Collin Times
text:
Rep. Keith Self, a U.S. Congressman who won re-election in both 2022 and 2024 against Sandeep Srivastava, recently posted a series of statements on social media concerning his activities in Congress and views on immigration.
On December 2, 2025, Rep. Self announced his leadership role in a congressional hearing focused on European affairs. He stated, “I am chairing a Europe Subcommittee hearing on the Balkans.
Tune in here. https://t.co/TbwyznFw9e” (posted December 2, 2025).
Later that day, he shared another post containing only a hyperlink: “https://t.co/bHhlehH3Us” (posted December 2, 2025).
In the evening, Rep. Self expressed strong opinions regarding immigration and assimilation in the United States. He wrote, “Coming to America is a PRIVILEGE, not a right.
Newcomers must assimilate to OUR culture, language, and values — or don’t come.
If you’re already here and refuse? You’ve got to go.
Restore American sovereignty. Protect Western Civilization.” (posted December 2, 2025).
Rep. Keith Self has maintained his seat through two recent election cycles. In the November 2024 general election, he defeated Sandeep Srivastava by securing approximately 62.5% of the vote compared to Srivastava’s 37.6%. Similarly, in the November 2022 contest against the same opponent, Self won with about 60.5% of the vote.
